old_description: Your one-stop shop for all your CAPA and Aftermarket replacement auto body parts. Serving the Greater Los Angeles area for over 15+ Years!
about:
Kar Parts Direct Co operates from Gardena, California, with a second location in North Hollywood. Founded in 2011, the company has served the Greater Los Angeles area for over a decade as a supplier of aftermarket auto body parts. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes CAPA-certified and aftermarket replacement auto body parts, maintaining an inventory of over 20,000 items including bumpers, fenders, and hoods. It offers will-call pickup and just-in-time delivery services from its two locations, supported by a fleet of branded delivery trucks and uniformed drivers. Quality verification processes include Vehicle Data Information (VDI), FMVSS-108 photometry durability testing, and Vehicle Test Fit (VTF) protocols.

Primary customers are collision repair shops, auto body shops, and automotive aftermarket businesses throughout Los Angeles County and surrounding cities. The company's product lines cover popular vehicle applications, and it emphasizes parts that fit without additional modification.

The company states its mission is to improve its business to satisfy customers through experienced staff, competitive pricing, and a broad product selection. It highlights CAPA-certified parts that undergo extensive testing as a quality differentiator.

name: Keach & Company Woodworking
old_description: Custom Woodworking is about making your visions come to life. Whether it’s a custom plaque to show appreciation or a handcrafted cabinet to showcase your favorite items, I’m here to bring your vision to life.
about:
Keach & Company Woodworking operates from Chester, Virginia, where owner Karl Keach has been accepting custom commissions since 2018. Keach’s background in woodworking traces back to his father, a high school shop teacher who passed along the craft; Karl has been building projects for family and friends for most of his life before turning the work into a business. The company serves clients both locally — providing in-person service across eastern Virginia — and nationally through its website and Etsy shop.

The shop produces custom wood pieces and laser-engraved items, including challenge-coin displays (in 12-, 26-, and 50-coin configurations), commemorative plaques for organizations such as the National Park Service, serving trays and charcuterie boards in maple and walnut, custom clocks, and furniture. All pieces are milled from solid hardwoods — primarily red oak, maple, and walnut — and finished to highlight natural grain. Laser engraving is offered on wood, gold-colored, and black surfaces, allowing for badges, logos, and personalized text. Production is a one-person operation, with each item built to order in small batches.

Customers span law-enforcement agencies, military units, park-ranger services, fire departments, veterans’ groups, and individual collectors. Concrete examples include a National Park Service Buffalo Badge plaque, a Chesterfield County Police badge engraving, and retirement displays for first responders. The business also creates personalized gifts for promotions, retirements, and service milestones.

Keach emphasizes a consultative approach, offering complimentary design consultations to translate each client’s vision into a finished piece. The focus on handcrafted solid-wood construction, customizable laser engraving, and direct communication with the maker is presented as the core distinction.

name: Kelley Bean Co Inc
old_description: From our humble beginnings in 1927, we have traveled along a sustainable path of growth to become one of the largest originators and marketers of dry edible beans in the world. We are an employee and family owned company that is headquartered in Scottsbluff, Nebraska.
about:
Kelley Bean Co. traces its roots to 1927 when the Chester B. Brown Company was founded in Morrill, Nebraska, with Robert L. Kelley Sr. as plant manager. In 1969, Robert L. Kelley Sr. and his son Gary L. Kelley established Kelley Bean Co. in Henry, Nebraska. The business, now headquartered in Scottsbluff, Nebraska, remains employee- and family-owned, with a fourth generation led by Kevin Kelley.

The company originates, processes, and markets dry edible beans — including Pinto, Great Northern, and numerous other varieties — sourced from a network of grower partnerships across the High Plains. Processing facilities run a "triple clean" line: screen sizing, gravity separation (including de-stoners), and optical electric-eye sorting, supplemented by rare-earth magnets, metal detection, and pre-wash equipment. Kelley Bean operates multiple GFSI-certified plants and maintains its own P.A.S.S. (Process Assuring Safety and Specification) food-safety system. Through a series of acquisitions — including ConAgra's dry-bean operations in 2006 and recent purchases in North Dakota and Minnesota — the company has become one of the largest U.S. originators and processors of dry beans.

Customers span food manufacturers, food-service distributors, retail packers, and international buyers. The company works directly with growers (farmers) to secure supply, and its products serve the canning, packaging, and pre-wash segments for retail and restaurant use.

Kelley Bean emphasizes absolute integrity, hard work, and community involvement as core values. Its differentiators include the internally developed P.A.S.S. system, full supply-chain control, risk-management programs, and a "grown in the USA" commitment.

old_description: KeyStone CoPack is your trusted partner for premium supplement manufacturing. From R&D to blending, filling, and packaging, we provide full turnkey services to bring your product to market with quality and efficiency.
about:
KeyStone Co-Pack Manufacturing, LLC is based in Pleasant Grove, Utah. The company does not publish its founding date or ownership details, but it presents itself as a turnkey co-pack partner for supplement and personal-care brands.

The firm provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for nutritional and cosmetic products. Its service chain covers ideation, formulation development, raw-material sourcing, production, packaging, and fulfillment. Production capabilities include powder blending and filling, capsule and tablet manufacturing, and packaging in jars, gusseted bags, bottles, sticks, sachets, tubs, and vials. The company notes a large inventory of hundreds of ingredients and custom formulas, but does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

KeyStone serves three primary industry groups: Food & Beverage (protein powders, baking mixes, unpasteurized beverage shots), Health & Wellness (protein blends, electrolytes, pre-workouts, performance and wellness powdered supplements), and Personal Care & Beauty (hair care, skin care, oral care products). Customers range from start-up brands to established companies seeking a single-source partner.

The company emphasizes its turnkey model as a differentiator, citing cost efficiency, access to a wider supplier network, regulatory knowledge, and specialized expertise. It also highlights responsible sourcing practices and nearby fulfillment partners to shorten delivery times.

old_description: Keystone specializes in assembly, kitting, packaging, converting and sterilization management from prototypes and pilot builds to full-scale production. Keystone also offers multiple clean room environments,  supply chain sourcing, warehousing and distribution services.
about:
Keystone Solutions Group operates from Kalamazoo, Michigan, where it has provided medical device contract manufacturing services for more than 25 years. The company is led by President Jim Medsker and a leadership team that includes VP of Sales and Business Development Jason Barr, VP of Engineering Vaughn Gerber, and Director of Quality & Regulatory William Reinholt.

The company specializes in assembly, kitting, packaging, converting, and sterilization management, supporting programs from prototype and pilot builds through full-scale production. Its facility includes multiple clean room environments, and it extends beyond core manufacturing to offer supply chain sourcing, warehousing, and distribution services. A dedicated Customer Product Transfer Process manages product transfers from project planning to commercial release.

Keystone serves the medical device industry worldwide, producing single-use disposable and reusable medical products. Its customers range from start-ups to established OEMs seeking end-to-end manufacturing, packaging, and sterilization solutions.

The company emphasizes a collaborative approach that addresses regulatory, intellectual property, and commercial challenges, aiming to break the mold of typical OEM/contract manufacturer relationships. Its stated values focus on complete end-to-end solutions from concept through approval and production.

about:
Kifaru International operates from Riverton, Wyoming, where it designs and sells a line of hunting packs, technical apparel, duffels, and shelter systems. The company emphasizes an "American Made" positioning and collaborates with camouflage brands such as Mossy Oak and MultiCam. A founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are not disclosed in public sources.

No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The brand targets serious big-game hunters — elk, moose, caribou, and bear — as evidenced by its film series documenting hunts in Alaska, Colorado, Utah, and British Columbia. Customers include individual hunters and outdoor enthusiasts purchasing direct through the company's e-commerce site.

Kifaru differentiates itself through domestic manufacturing claims and limited-edition camouflage partnerships, notably the Mossy Oak Fall Foliage and Treestand patterns. The company also produces a media arm, Kifaru Films, which publishes hunt documentaries on YouTube to build community around the gear.

name: Kiliper Corporation
old_description: For over 25 years, Kiliper Corp, an Inovar company, has delivered high-quality packaging solutions with a focus on stretch sleeves, flexible packaging, and roll-fed label technologies. Known for quick turnaround times, flexible production, and dependable service, Kiliper helps brands move faster while maintaining consistent quality. From full-container decoration to high-speed labeling applications, Kiliper provides solutions designed to perform across a wide range of industries including food & beverage, household products, industrial, and more.
about:
Kiliper Corporation operates from Ames, Iowa, where it has produced packaging solutions for more than 25 years. The business was built on a family-owned foundation and now operates as part of Inovar Packaging Group, a national packaging partner that provides expanded resources and a broader manufacturing network while maintaining Kiliper's responsive, service-driven approach.

The company specializes in stretch sleeve labeling, roll-fed label technologies, and flexible packaging solutions, supported by advanced flexographic printing capabilities and deep material expertise. Its offerings include printed and laminated film solutions, sustainable and recyclable packaging options, and prepress services. Kiliper also runs an innovation lab at Inovar headquarters for research and development and provides vendor-managed inventory programs to streamline supply chains.

Kiliper serves brands across food and beverage, personal and home care, industrial, pet care, agricultural chemical, supplements and nutraceuticals, household products, and agriculture markets. Its stretch sleeves conform to container shapes using material elasticity, eliminating heat or adhesives, while roll-fed labels are designed for high-speed application and seamless container coverage.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround times, adaptable production capabilities, and a hands-on, customer-first team focused on long-term partnerships. Its differentiators include specialized expertise in stretch sleeve and roll-fed label applications, reliable processes that ensure consistent quality, and scalable support through Inovar's nationwide network.
